label: Every GOD_4 exists at w and has power for the actual contingents' joint absence
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (analyst formulation, unattributed): every GOD_4 exists at w and has at w a power (PowerFor) for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w. The directional identification that brings #1897's holder premises to GOD_4: not uniqueness and not that every holder is GOD_4. Motivation, navigation only: on classical theism God could have refrained from creating (ST I q.19 a.3).
